description: Accessibility tree of the page with a ref id per element; use refs with browser_computer (clicks, scroll_to) and browser_form_input. filter=interactive returns only clickable/editable elements — a compact map of the page. Read-only. Refs go stale after navigation or heavy DOM changes; call again to refresh.

filter.description: interactive — only clickable/editable elements; default all

tabId.description: tab id from browser_tabs_list or browser_tab_create

name: browser_read_page
